knownLimits: Current bridge and culvert elevations unknown; no structure openings
Published CN antecedent assumption (GCN10 fair ARCII undrained); no measured transmission loss

Terrain is bare-earth lidar: 1 m PimaCounty_2021_B21 and Eastern_PimaCO_2015 in road/wash windows (2015 covers most of the mid/upper Brawley mainstem and San Joaquin/Black Wash); 10 m context mixes all-route-context-v2, 2021, BrawleyRillito 2018 (flown 2019), 2015 and 0.98 km2 of USGS 1/3 arc-second; not a 2026 survey
2021 minus 2015 seam offset about -0.11 m median in 7 road windows; not corrected
6.25 m computational cells are not validated road-depth accuracy; compare cell water-surface elevation zs with road height, never averaged depth
The 27.47 km2 local catchment of 15876941 below USGS 09487000 is excluded; its runoff enters only through the inlet series

Directed network independence does not prove no cross-divide overland exchange; overlaps Gates by 139.42 km2; west-valley subtrees drain toward Northern, which keeps its own NWM inlets (independent model)

Domain v2 (1240 km2) adds the west-valley subtrees of Northern inlets 15876639/653/641/623, Pump Station tributaries 15876613/15876627 and terminal subtrees 15876757/719/669/675; 19 candidate dips (6 >= 1 m, mostly W Silverbell Rd and N Red Hill Rd near 32.445 N) remain in no model
Road heights exist only inside the floodplain-road-heights-v1 tile box (about lon >= -111.44, lat >= 32.146); roads outside it have no comparison
SENSITIVITY v2r: rain 14Z Nov 1..18Z Nov 2 is observed Stage IV 01h (no HRRR); this is an after-the-fact observed-rain test, not something a forecast-time run could have had
SENSITIVITY v3l-obsrain: v2r observed-rain case with the boundaries v3 lobe-tip outflow cells only (5 cells, 52 in all); not calibrated, not tuned to observations, not for live registration

terrainSources.road1m: USGS 3DEP 1 m windows .sfincs-runs/brawley-avra-west-terrain-1m-v1 (162 new + reused) plus -v2 top-up (146 new); PimaCounty_2021_B21 > BrawleyRillito_2018_D19 > Eastern_PimaCO_2015
terrainSources.context10m: .sfincs-runs/brawley-avra-west-context-v2 (16.97 km2 USGS 1/3 arc-second where no 1 m exists; no L3/L4 zone there)

scope.outflow: open outflows where the Brawley local set and the west-valley subtrees join water carried by the Northern case (HydroMT directed outflow points); terminal subtrees end inside the domain
scope.roadOwnership: owns every area-tile road station inside its domain that is more than 15 m from a rated route (rated-route stations stay with the route cases)
scope.limitation: Directed network independence does not prove no cross-divide overland exchange

inflow.gauge: USGS 09487000 Brawley Wash near Three Points (provisional IV 00060)
inflow.note: Same observed inflow file as v2r/v2x. SENSITIVITY base case B: v2r with only the boundary mask changed. Not for live registration.

window.rain: SENSITIVITY: frozen v2 observation-based analysis frames 2026-10-30T16Z..2026-11-01T13Z unchanged, then observed Stage IV 01h (IEM) for every hour 14Z Nov 1..17Z Nov 2 on the same grid and mapping; no HRRR, no MRMS needed, no zero-fill
window.note: SENSITIVITY base case B (v3l-obsrain) on the v2x validation window. Not a live configuration and not tuned.

label: SENSITIVITY - not for live registration

rainSensitivity.label: SENSITIVITY: rain forcing inherited byte-identical from v2r (precip_2d.nc unchanged); v2r was the all-observed-rain variant of v2x. Not tuned to observations; not for live registration
rainSensitivity.comparesWith: brawley-avra-west-native-case-v2r-observed-inflow (run 42555458619): same rain, same inflow; the only difference is boundaryChange (5 lobe-tip outflow cells)
rainSensitivity.rainProvenance: The fields below describe how the v2r rain was built from v2x (run 42544624673); they are not a comparison of this case with v2x, which also differs by the boundary change
rainSensitivity.v2rHypothesis: The frozen HRRR 2026-11-01T14Z forecast misses most of the 14-17Z Stage IV rain (domain mean 0.67 mm vs 19.46 mm) and puts the burst 2-3 h late; this may explain why ALERT 6443 at Mile Wide gets 11.8 m3/s at 03Z in v2x vs about 23.1 m3/s observed and why the wave is late
rainSensitivity.v2rRainDifferenceFromV2x: precipitation frames 2026-11-01T14Z..2026-11-02T06Z (17 hourly frames, interval starts)

unchangedFrames.frozenObservedAnalysis: 2026-10-30T16Z..2026-11-01T13Z (46 frames, frozen Stage IV/MRMS resolved analysis, byte-identical forcing)
unchangedFrames.observedExtension: 2026-11-02T07Z..2026-11-02T17Z (11 frames, same Stage IV files as v2x, identical values)

replacedFrames.to: observed NCEP Stage IV 01h via IEM

rainSensitivity.source: IEM archive ST4.<YYYYMMDDHH>.01h.grib, same header checks, HRAP md5GridSection 63636ab709e74db430bd6c1a05f419e1 and the frozen nearest-cell mapping (tools/sfincs/brawley/extend/fetch_stage4_extension.py)

added.why: NHDPlus 15876709 is digitized flowing south but the 10 m terrain falls 23.4 m to the north (617.76 m at its digitized start, 641.15 m at its end); reversed for the HydroMT outflow search only; OSM intermittent stream 1103245450 continues north to the Avra Valley Rd bridge (docs/upgrade/BRAWLEY-OUTLET-POND-20261108.md)

boundaryChange.method: Same boundary type (msk 3 outflow) and the same HydroMT directed outflow-point search (100 m edge buffer, 250 m corridor, Deltares native mask builder) as the 47 v2 outflow cells; the 5 lobe-tip cells are the same 5 faces as in boundaries v3
boundaryChange.unchanged: mesh v2, parameters v2 (sfincs_subgrid.nc), infiltration.nc, observed inflow, all-observed rain precip_2d.nc, sfincs.inp, sfincs.dis, sfincs.src are byte-identical to the v2r case; in sfincs.nc only mask differs (faces 54443, 54444, 54598, 54599, 54756: 1 -> 3)

notAdded.what: the two NW valley-floor OSM outfalls of boundaries v3 (OSM 1489567542, 5 cells; OSM 1489567547, 35 cells)
notAdded.why: in run 42567934972 they passed only about 43k m3 but turned the cells of 10 road stations (9 W Silverbell Rd, 1 N Cocio Rd; faces 32266 and 465513) into outflow cells that hold zs at the bed, and the v2 NW outflow dropped by about 101k m3 with no explanation
